interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area and GOAL.EXE memory (the match clock DS:831F/831D/8325/831B, the seed DS:7B62, the score DS:9B3C/9B3D, the commentary ring, the squad words and every squad player's +0x12 rating word, the man-of-the-match word DS:7C3A) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
savestates written at every read; one loaded (Host+L): the start state; the match runs watched from the captain screen

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147), game folder recreated from the verified release copy, GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads E006's published main-screen savestate whose sha256 is given (e006-1001-r0002.sav, release E006; the start state of E010's runs from the same E006 run); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); DOS clock of this session not set
